title: Use English source keys in save forms
changes: Migrate twelve save form message keys to English while retaining legacy Italian keys and identical English and Italian presentations.
validation: Offline Linux combined menu/screen build passed eight localization tests and the save-state layout test, including legacy-key equivalence and rendered empty-slot text in both languages. Both 523-entry language catalogs passed consistency checks.
limitations: Native Windows, physical input and full runtime frontend builds were not checked; the wider English-first audit remains open.
